evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 茹古涵今
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坦坦蕩蕩之南為茹古涵今五楹南向其後方殿為韶景軒四面各五楹韶景軒前東為茂育齋西為竹香齋又北為靜通齋（圓圓明園册）臣等謹按茹古涵今四十景之一也額為皇上御書韶景軒額恭懸軒内其外南簷額曰喜接南薰東簷額曰景麗東皇西簷額曰翠生西嶺北簷額曰清風北户與竹香齋額皆御書茂育齋静通齋額皆世宗御書
evidence.summary: South of 坦坦蕩蕩: the five-bay 茹古涵今 facing south; behind it the square 韶景軒 of five bays per side, with a plaque on each of its four eaves; 茂育齋, 竹香齋 and 靜通齋 around it.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 竹香斋, 5x1 cells.
